# White Rose Cars

> White Rose Cars is an independent, family-run used car dealer in Roundhay, Leeds. We keep a small,
> carefully chosen selection of used cars and describe each one honestly, including its mileage, history
> and any insurance category. Viewings are by appointment, including evenings and weekends, and we can
> arrange nationwide delivery.

Based at 408 Oakwood Lane, Leeds LS8 3LG. Part exchange is welcome, card payments are accepted, and a
warranty is provided with our cars — ask us what is covered on the car you are interested in.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.whiterosecarsales.co.uk/): current stock and how to arrange a viewing
- [Stock](https://www.whiterosecarsales.co.uk/stock.php): filter used cars by make, model, body type, fuel, price and mileage
- [Finance](https://www.whiterosecarsales.co.uk/finance.php): finance options discussed individually — ask for a personalised quotation
- [Part exchange](https://www.whiterosecarsales.co.uk/sell-your-car.php): part-exchange your current car against one of ours
- [Warranty](https://www.whiterosecarsales.co.uk/warranty.php): what is covered, for how long, and how to claim
- [About us](https://www.whiterosecarsales.co.uk/about-us.php): independent dealer in Roundhay, Leeds
- [Contact](https://www.whiterosecarsales.co.uk/contact.php): call 07960 015378 or arrange a viewing
- [FAQ](https://www.whiterosecarsales.co.uk/faq.php): buying, finance, warranty and part exchange questions
- [Buyers guide](https://www.whiterosecarsales.co.uk/buyers-guide.php): step-by-step used car buying advice
- [Privacy policy](https://www.whiterosecarsales.co.uk/privacy.php)
- [Complaints policy](https://www.whiterosecarsales.co.uk/complaints-policy.php)
